text:
bryce: Quick sync — AtlasHealth POC wraps this Friday. Need final deprovision timeline for Hosted API keys, Dedicated pool, and VPC handoff. Who owns key invalidation?

nisha: I can own keys + creds rotation. Plan: revoke hosted API tokens, rotate any service principals in the VPC, and schedule dedicated pool drain. ETA today EOD?

jordan: For Dedicated pool we need to drain GPU jobs, snapshot KV caches, then shut down. I recommend 2-step: set pool to read-only, wait 30m, then deprovision. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

amy: Legal wants 90 days retention for artifacts unless customer requests earlier deletion. Need written confirmation from AtlasHealth to apply shorter retention. @legal any pushback?

legal: Confirmed: we need signed deletion waiver to drop below 90d. Otherwise follow default retention. I'll DM AtlasHealth and put reply in this thread.

nisha: Ops steps (rough):
```bash
# revoke hosted API key
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.ai/v1/keys/atlas-poc-01"
# mark dedicated pool for drain
rbctl pools update atlas-poc --mode drain
# remove VPC peering
aws ec2 delete-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc123
```
I'll put exact IDs in internal ticket.

devops_oncall: Heads up: if you delete KMS keys, any snapshots encrypted with them become unreadable. Recommend schedule KMS schedule to disable then schedule deletion after 7 days.

bryce: Good catch. Let's not hard-delete KMS. Plan: disable -> 7d -> delete if waiver.

jordan: Also, cache sweep: clear prefix/KV caches used in POC to avoid leakage. Use runtime API:
```json
POST /runtime/cache/clear { "prefix": "atlas-poc/" }
```

amy: Atlas sent back signed waiver at 1747654600, attached to ticket. We can shorten retention to 14 days.

bryce: OK proceed with accelerated plan. nisha, jordan, create a runbook with exact IDs and schedule start at 1747654800 (in 10 mins). Confirm here when started.

nisha: Runbook created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-1023 — starting at 1747654800. I'll post progress updates here.

deploy-bot: scheduled job pool-drain-atlas-poc queued for 1747654800

nisha: Started drain. pool mode: draining. active connections: 2. :eyes:

jordan: KV cache cleared. command returned OK.

nisha: Hosted API key atlas-poc-01 revoked at 1747654860

devops_oncall: KMS key disabled (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01) — scheduled deletion at 7d from now per policy.

amy: Confirming data retention set to 14 days per signed waiver.

bryce: All done from our side? Final check: any logs we need to preserve for compliance?

legal: We'll archive logs for 180 days internally as part of audit trail, but not customer data. Done.

bryce: Thanks team. Closing ticket and sending Atlas an exit note. :rocket:
